\chapter{Tool Chain}
\label{part:toolchain}

The tool chain consists of an assembler and a virtual machine. The assembler is a simple compiler, that transforms the instructions described in the previous chapter and the pseudo instructions described in this chapter into a well-defined binary format. The virtual machine reads one or more files containing such bytecode and executes the encoded program.
